text:
ana: Quick Q on API contract for model selection when clients send `model_hint` + `region_hint` — does server need to error if mismatch in region?
matt: No error. We decided to treat `region_hint` as advisory and perform best-effort routing; only error if `model_id` is pinned to a private deployment in another region.
ana: Where is that in the spec? I only see `routing_priority` and `model_id` fields.
jing: Not yet published. Proposed fields in PR 342: `model_hint` (string), `routing_hints` (array), `compat_mode` (enum: strict|best_effort|legacy).
sam: For backward compatibility, default should be `legacy` which preserves current behavior (model_id required, other hints ignored).
ana: Can we have example payload?
matt: yes
```json
{
  "model_hint": "redwood/fastchat-13b",
  "routing_hints": ["us-west1", "dedicated"],
  "compat_mode": "best_effort"
}
```
infra-bot: deploy queued for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC - will run API schema migration in staging.
jing: Fallback order: 1) exact model_id, 2) model family variant (quantized/float), 3) compatible open model alias, 4) hosted default. Do we want to expose that order in response as `served_from`?
sam: Yes please. Add `served_from` with one of ["model_id","family_variant","alias","default"].
ana: And what about cost-tier routing? `routing_hints` can include `cost_tier:low`? or separate field `cost_tier`?
matt: prefer separate `cost_tier` string so we can validate values. Allowed: "low","standard","premium". If mismatch, best-effort picks cheapest that meets latency SLO given `compat_mode`.
ana: Will this break existing clients if they send unexpected fields? We should ignore unknown keys.
jing: Agreed — server must ignore unknown fields. We should add that sentence to API contract and add an integration test that posts {"weird":1}.
ana: I'll open a tiny PR to update openapi and add the tests. Ping me for review @matt @jing.
matt: SG, will review today. Also add a note about streaming response: `served_from` must appear in first JSON metadata chunk.
sam: FYI product asked for region hint to be honored for data residency only when `data_residency:strict` is set; otherwise advisory.
ana: Good call. I'll add `data_residency` enum. Thanks all :thumbsup:
